intro: Financial services and government organisations were the primary targets across 64 phishing incidents reported between April and August 2026, with the majority rated high severity. Threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit were observed in these campaigns, which affected regions including Latin America, the United States, Canada, and Russia. Exploitation frequently involved CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The cryptocurrency, hospitality, and technology sectors also faced exposure, while the remaining eight incidents were assessed as medium severity.
